rlcd_note: per row loss (train.losses.rlcd_loss, PROPER form v2 after review B 2026-10-08) = -log p(gold) + [score questions] RPS + record x share of -log prod p(gold) over the record's questions (a log-product = mean log score) + beta x KL(p || p_D1) + brier x Brier. Every scoring term is strictly proper, so with p_D1 calibrated the fixed point is p = p_D1 (v1's 1 - E_p[reward] term was linear in p, improper: it sharpened toward proj(2q)). Partial credit on score questions is ADJACENT-ONLY (adjacent_credit 0.5 at |k - gold| = 1, else 0), pre-registered here; it is the logged expected-reward bookkeeping, the ordinal structure is trained through RPS. p_D1 = the same forward with D1's tensors swapped in (no grad; ~+1 forward per step). Record term: data order is record-contiguous; a record's questions outside the current row group enter through a detached p(gold) cache (a constant in the log-product). Weights are pre-registered guesses (Clef publishes none): beta 0.1 keeps the policy near D1, brier 0.5.
